messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: sustained queue growth on dedicated-prod-usw1-1. 95th queue latency > 2s for 4m. Paging oncall.
oncall-alice: saw alert. jumping in. pulling realtime dashboards and tailing logs.
sre-ben: quick status check: are we throttling anywhere? any recent deploys?
eng-ryan: no recent deploys. seeing one customer group (corp-alpha) with heavy bursty streaming sessions hitting same model shard — looks like hot-shard behavior.
infra-carla: pool has a cold burst reserve: 3 GPUs. can enable via infra CLI. spin-up ~25-40s for nodes + runtime attach ~40-60s.
oncall-alice: plan: 1) toggle burst +3 GPUs, 2) apply temporary per-customer QPS window for impacted enterprise accounts, 3) enable soft global rate limit for free-tier to preserve capacity. anyone object?
pm-dave: make sure to note customer-facing impact and TTLs so we can message account teams.

infra-carla: recommended safe command:
```
redwood infra pool-burst enable --pool dedicated-prod-usw1-1 --count 3 --reason "oncall: queue spike" --drain-new-nodes=false
```

oncall-alice: running it now.
```
> redwood infra pool-burst enable --pool dedicated-prod-usw1-1 --count 3 --reason "oncall: queue spike" --drain-new-nodes=false
```
oncall-alice: :hourglass: nodes provisioning.
sre-ben: watching metrics — tailing 95th queue, cpu, and model-server register events.
infra-carla: runtime registration complete. pool capacity from 9->12 GPUs.
oncall-alice: :white_check_mark: burst applied. noticeable drop in queue within 60s: 95th from ~2100ms -> ~480ms.
eng-ryan: still seeing shard hotness for corp-alpha. recommend ephemeral QPS increase for corp-alpha/corp-gamma so their clients stop retrying and amplifying load.
oncall-alice: setting ephemeral QPS +40% ttl 15m for corp-alpha and corp-gamma.

infra-carla: use:
```
redwood quota adjust --customer corp-alpha --qps +40% --ttl 15m --reason "mitigation"
```

oncall-alice: applied to both accounts. monitoring.
sre-ben: corp-alpha success rate jumps to 99.4% in ~90s. system 95th latency holding ~500ms.
eng-ryan: to reduce background noise, toggling noncritical features for free-tier: disable async-rerank and reduce streaming fallback concurrency to 1 for free-tier routes.
oncall-alice: please tag changes so we can easily revert.
eng-ryan: done:
```
redwood config set --env prod --route "/v1/rerank" --feature async_rerank false --tag "oncall-1845678901"
redwood config set --env prod --route "/v1/stream" --feature streaming_fallback_concurrency 1 --tag "oncall-1845678901"
```

sre-ben: free-tier 429s nudged up slightly (~1.5%) but enterprise unaffected. overall CPU usage down ~10%.
pm-dave: I'm drafting an account note for corp-alpha/gamma explaining temporary QPS bump and that we're monitoring; will send to their CSMs once you confirm stability.
oncall-alice: confirm stable for now. ben, can you take watch and do a handoff in 30m?
sre-ben: will do. setting a 1h watch reminder. also creating follow-ups: 1) tune auto-burst trigger (current 95th > 1500ms for 3m), 2) evaluate shard-aware routing to avoid hot-shard collapse, 3) consider automated temporary free-tier soft-throttle during spikes.
infra-carla: note: burst reserve left after this action is 0 for that region. if another surge occurs, plan B is cross-region routing to dedicated-prod-usw2 and/or emergency per-route throttles.
oncall-alice: logging incident and actions.
incident-bot: Incident recorded: INC-2026-0316-07. Owner: sre-ben. Summary: burst +3 GPUs enabled on dedicated-prod-usw1-1, ephemeral QPS +40% for corp-alpha/corp-gamma (ttl 15m), free-tier features disabled/reduced concurrency to ease load. Follow-ups assigned to infra-carla and eng-ryan.
eng-ryan: posting links for handoff:
- pool metrics: https://dash.redwood.internal/m/pool/dedicated-prod-usw1-1
- request traces: https://traces.redwood.internal/q/INC-2026-0316-07
- audit log (commands): https://logs.redwood.internal/audits/INC-2026-0316-07
sre-ben: handover notes: keep burst until metrics stable for 20m, watch 95th queue < 700ms. if surge recurs and burst depleted, enable automated routing to usw2 and enable emergency free-tier throttle 50%.
oncall-alice: thanks all. leaving detailed checklist in tracker. off duty — pass to ben. :wave:
sre-ben: taking over watch. will add item to quarterly infra retro: consider automatic burst refill/priority for enterprise during peak and a safer, quicker runtime attach flow.
pm-dave: thanks team. will coordinate comms post-incident.
